scope: Read-only diagnosis of the initial PR Download failure and observation of the final candidate. This report does not claim that all CI is green.

exactCookieReplay.recording: First failing job artifact, exact checkpoint5 plus its recorded Cookie RNG stream

interpretation.observed: The failing Cookie cascade is finite and reaches the exact authoritative next state. Dango and all other engines had settled before the runtime timeout.
interpretation.likelyMechanism: Existing Cookie Engine.wait subtracts requested timer slices, while Download settlement limits actual elapsed time. Delayed callbacks can stretch a finite animation beyond90seconds.
interpretation.randomness: Download recording uses separate seeded cookie and dango streams, so extra Dango RNG consumption does not shift the recorded Cookie tape. Different run seeds can still produce different Cookie cascades.
interpretation.limits: A pure-engine replay establishes finite deterministic behavior, not full-browser timing. Renderer load or a different cascade may affect later runs; the browser result remains necessary.
